required_tests.must_fail_if: Gate4 001B is used as pass evidence
provisional Gate4 001C is read, restored, copied, imported, or used
a metric or verdict is produced from a literal, constant, or static dictionary
a baseline is declared but not invoked
an ablation changes labels without rerunning episodes
replay does not recompute behavior from serialized state plus observation
leakage positive controls are not detected
frozen seeds, train/heldout contexts, or counterfactual pairs are declared but unused
any downstream authorization field becomes true

forbidden_test_pattern: tests that only assert final pass
